lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: Juggling two kitchens — Bengali for me and Mili, Marwari veg for Sanjay and Papaji, plus his sugar.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Blinkit for daily stuff, BigBasket for monthly. Later for sign in though.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Blinkit mostly, BigBasket for monthly restocks. If Blinkit doesn't have something, I check BigBasket.
Q: I have Debjani (44), Sanjay (46), Mili (9) and Omprakash (77) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: No one else. That's all four of us.
Q: Pushpa cooks Mon-Sat: Breakfast and Lunch at 7am, Dinner at 6pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: That's right. Pushpa does breakfast and lunch at 7, dinner at 6. No other meals.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: No, she's fine on time. Makes everything we need.
A: oh, Pushpa comes at 7:30 in the evening now, not 6
Q: On Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: I cook everything on Sunday. No eating out usually.
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Mili had toast most days, poha twice, besan chilla once. Sunday she had luchi.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Mili takes a tiffin Mon-Fri: sandwich, paratha roll, pasta on Fridays.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Mili eats what we eat for dinner, less spicy. Roti, dal and a sabzi mostly.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Same as Mili mostly: toast, poha, besan chilla. Sunday luchi and cholar dal for all.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Lunch is usually rice, dal, a sabzi like aloo posto or gatte, and roti. Kadhi sometimes.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Dinner: roti, dal and a sabzi. Macher jhol twice for me and Mili. Papaji has bajra roti at night, no rice.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: Papaji is diabetic, no sugar at all, no rice at night. Less salt for him too.
Q: Do the elders eat anything differently from the rest: less salt, softer food, no onion or garlic, a fasting day?
A: Papaji has less salt, no sugar, no rice at night. Sanjay and Papaji are pure veg, no eggs. No fasting days fixed.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: No beef in the house. Me and Mili eat fish and eggs, Sanjay and Papaji are pure veg. No fixed fasting days.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Rarely, no fixed day. Maybe once or twice a month.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Milk packets every morning from a local dairy delivery, nothing else on subscription.
